response: General relativity is a theory of gravitation that was developed by Albert Einstein between 1907 and 1915. According to general relativity, the observed gravitational effect between masses results from their warping of spacetime. However, it is not necessary to consider spacetime as a fabric that can be bent; the theory can be understood purely in terms of mathematical equations. General relativity extends the principle of relativity to include all physical laws, and it is generally taken as a given in most modern work that spacetime itself carries energy.
